title: Quick-Charred Indian Leek Samosa
description: A quick and flavorful Indian-inspired dish featuring charred leeks in a crispy samosa wrapper, served in a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 1-2 seconds.
Add finely chopped leeks and cook for 3-4 minutes until slightly charred.
Add garam masala, salt, red chili powder, and amchur powder.
Mix well and cook for another minute.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut the dough into small squares and place a spoonful of the leek mixture in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Fry the samosas until golden brown.
Drain the samosas on paper towels.
Serve in a dolsot stone bowl with a dollop of chutney, if desired.
